CustomColors.description: The five parts of a custom theme (design 3G), each a #rrggbb colour.
CustomColors.title: CustomColors

PreferencesPatch.description:
Any subset. Unknown keys are rejected so a typo never silently does nothing. The server checks the *shape* of
a theme id; what it means is up to the app, so an older app and a newer server never break each other.
PreferencesPatch.title: PreferencesPatch

post.description: Ends this session on the server (not just in the browser), so a copied cookie stops working.
Ends every session of this user, on every browser. For a shared or lost computer.

One chat turn. Made as the logged-in user and nobody else: the id comes from the session cookie, never
from the body, and the Langflow session id is built from it here.

get.description: Public: the registration form needs it, and it contains nothing private.

post.description:
Permanently deletes the account and everything in it, including the chat history Langflow stores. Needs the
password. The Langflow side goes first and must be confirmed: if it can't be, nothing is deleted and the
learner is told to retry, because deleting the account row would leave their chat with no way to find it.
Changes the password and ends every OTHER session (a stolen login must not survive the change).

patch.description: Saves display preferences on the account so they follow the learner to every browser.

get.description: Public: what the privacy page and sign-up form need to show.

Public: the privacy policy copy to show for `lang`. Only an approved, current copy is ever served; otherwise
the English copy, with fallback=true (design 3I).

post.description: Remember which words the learner got right or wrong, so the due ones come back (spaced repetition).

get.description: Multiple-choice cards from this learner's own words that have a meaning (made on the spot, no AI).
Fill-in-the-blank items from one of THIS learner's saved stories, blanking only words from their own list.
Words to hear and type. The browser reads them aloud, so the server only picks them (any word, a meaning is not needed).
due=true: only the words that are due now, then words never practised.

delete.description: Its words go back to General; none are deleted.

post.description:
Saves a story to the library. The report is made here, from the learner's own words; a report or a pass sent by the
page is never read (it is not even a field).
Makes one story from THIS learner's words and checks it. Nothing is saved; the learner saves it from the page.
Writes meanings for up to 25 of the learner's words that have none and says how many are still without one.
Moves the learner's own words into one of their sets, or back to General. Words in another language than the set stay put.

get.description: Ready-made packs of everyday words for this language, and how many of each the learner does not have yet.
